Apex Horizon is a driving-awareness aid, not a navigation system and not a safety system. Always follow the road, traffic signs and speed limits. Suggested speeds are estimates based on road geometry and may be wrong. Mount your phone securely before you start, never touch it while the vehicle is moving, and never rely on this app instead of your own judgement.
Turn on location services so Apex Horizon can read your speed and position.
A live drive needs your precise location to show speed and predict the road ahead. Choose “Precise” when asked, or allow it in the app settings. You can also try the Demo without any permission.

Apex Horizon blends GPS, the gyroscope and accelerometer into a smooth speed read-out and a predicted path. With the camera on, the path is drawn over the live road. Without it, the same HUD is drawn on a synthetic horizon. When GPS is weak or light is low, the confidence score drops and the app tells you it is estimating instead of inventing a line.

Apex Horizon has no accounts, no ads and no analytics. The internet is used only to download the offline map files you choose; your location and destinations are never sent anywhere. Camera frames are analysed on the device for brightness only and are never stored or sent. Location is used only while a drive screen is open. Saved runs stay on this device until you delete them.
Location: speed, heading and route matching while driving. Camera (optional): live road view and light level. You can use the app without the camera.
